scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof is provided. Numerical checks are supplementary and are not proofs of the all-dimensional result.
scientific_limitations: Fixed dimension and fixed nondegenerate side lengths; asymptotic limit only
Does not give a finite-threshold exact section-area distribution or uniform convergence in degenerating shapes
Historical priority remains conditional on inaccessible full text of Paul (1981) and other possible unindexed equivalents
title: A Dirichlet corner law for tiny random sections of orthotopes
